skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop skills in conducting independent research, including problem identification and solution development in project management.
Apply theoretical knowledge to practical project management scenarios, including planning, execution, and evaluation.
Enhance ability to analyze and synthesize information to solve complex problems in project management.
Demonstrate capacity for self-directed learning and continuous professional development.
Work effectively in teams and independently to achieve project goals.
Improve skills in written and oral communication, including report writing and presentation.
Adhere to ethical standards and professional conduct in academic and practical settings.
Manage time effectively to meet project deadlines and deliverables.
